purpose: Test a new market-state-invariant dual-compression mechanism on a previously unseen identity fold without modifying or rescuing the rejected V2.8.5 CALM-conditioner hypothesis.

V2.8.1.note: Both factors had strong monotonic rank-IC evidence in 2025-2026 but failed the old V2.8.1 promotion rule only because the D10 quintile-spread CI did not exclude zero.

V2.8.5_fold0.interpretation: The rejected element was CALM superiority. Both factors remained directionally positive in both market states.

identity_folds.frame: All securities whose official PIT interval intersects 2023-01-01 through 2024-12-31.
identity_folds.fold0: Already consumed by V2.8.5; development evidence only.
identity_folds.fold1: V2.8.6 independent mechanism replication; may be read only after this contract and fold manifest are frozen.
identity_folds.fold2: Reserved untouched for future Setup-shape research.
identity_folds.fold3: Reserved untouched for future Setup validation.

mechanism.name: STATE_INVARIANT_DUAL_COMPRESSION
mechanism.reason: Equal-weight rank combination is scale-free, threshold-free and uses no result-fitted coefficient.

population_and_source.stock_query_adjustflag: 1 with V2.8.5 Amendment-2 row-flag integrity semantics

outcomes.primary: Exact joint-session D+10 same-source post-adjusted close return.
outcomes.secondary: Exact joint-session D+5 same-source post-adjusted close return.

market_state.definition: Same frozen V2.8.5 CSI300 rv10/rv60 market state: CALM iff ratio <= 1, STRESSED otherwise.
market_state.role: Replication strata only. No state is claimed to be superior.

statistical_mechanics.daily_metric: Spearman correlation of dual_compression_score versus forward return within date.
statistical_mechanics.multiplicity: None; one preregistered primary composite hypothesis.
statistical_mechanics.quarter_stability: Positive all-market D+10 mean IC in at least two-thirds of valid quarters and every leave-one-valid-quarter-out mean > 0.

pass_requires_all: All-market 95% moving-block bootstrap CI is entirely above zero.
CALM mean D+10 composite Rank-IC > 0 and its 95% CI is entirely above zero.
STRESSED mean D+10 composite Rank-IC > 0 and its 95% CI is entirely above zero.
Every leave-one-valid-quarter-out all-market D+10 mean remains > 0.
Both component factors have positive direction-adjusted all-market D+10 mean IC.
No source, PIT, calendar or implementation blocker.

promotion_effect.PASS: May advance to a separate V2.8.7 Setup-shape research contract using untouched fold2.
promotion_effect.FAIL: Do not build a Setup around dual-compression.
promotion_effect.all_states: No Setup, Episode, First60 or live authorization.

forbidden: No CALM superiority or CALM-minus-STRESSED gate.
No coefficient fitting or threshold search on fold1.
No inspection-driven change to fold assignment, composite weights, market-state definition, horizons, bootstrap or PASS conditions.
No use of fold2, fold3 or fold4 during V2.8.6.
No modification of V2.8.3 or V2.8.5 terminal results.
